messages.snippet: All, I'm pleased to confirm that the acquisition of Helix Logistics by Bracken has completed today,
messages.subject: Project Relay - COMPLETION confirmed
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm that the acquisition of Helix Logistics by Bracken has completed today, 8 November 2024. The executed SPA is attached for the file. Consideration of GBP 38,000,000 has been settled - GBP 22,800,000 to Marcus and GBP 15,200,000 to Lucy - less the GBP 3,800,000 retention paid into escrow.

Thank you all for a constructive process. Closing bible to follow next week.

Best,
Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

Release mechanics for the file: first release of 50 per cent. (GBP 1,900,000) on the First Release Date of 8 November 2025, and the balance on the Final Release Date of 8 August 2026 (21 months), in each case less any outstanding claims. Executed escrow agreement attached.

Tom

messages.subject: RE: Project Relay - disclosure letter & funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
Charlotte, Richard,

For completeness: the sellers' disclosure letter, dated 8 November and effective immediately before completion, is attached - it qualifies the warranties and records the customer-concentration and vehicle-fleet (operating lease) disclosures. The funds flow ran as planned: GBP 38,000,000 consideration, GBP 3,800,000 into the Hanover Trust escrow, net proceeds to the sellers' solicitors. The buy-side W&I policy (GBP 19,000,000 limit) incepted at exchange.

Best,
Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
